operations.name: EMSIActiveEmojis
EMSIHomeFeed
operations.body:
query EMSIHomeFeed($mode: HomeFeedMode = FOR_YOU, $cursor: String) {
	homeFeed(mode: $mode, cursor: $cursor) {
		items {
			type
			id
			reason {
				key
				args
				text
				systemImage
			}
			controls
			trackingToken
			post {
				id
				channelID
				channelName
				author {
					id
					fullName
					city
					avatarURL
				}
				body
				createdAt
				likeCount
				replyCount
				isLiked
				mediaURL
				mediaKind
				thumbnailURL
				blurhash
				width
				height
			}
			event {
				id
				title
				summary
				channelID
				channelName
				city
				venue
				date
				capacity
				joinedCount
				waitingCount
				status
				participation
				tags
				host {
					id
					fullName
					city
					avatarURL
				}
			}
			liveRoom {
				id
				channelID
				title
				subtitle
				participantCount
				participants {
					id
					fullName
					city
					avatarURL
				}
			}
			channelPulse {
				channelID
				channelName
				accentName
				summary
				newPostCount
				previews {
					id
					authorName
					snippet
				}
			}
			friendActivity {
				id
				actor {
					id
					fullName
					city
					avatarURL
				}
				text
				systemImage
				targetID
			}
		}
		nextCursor
		refreshCursor
		generatedAt
	}
}
